title: 推敲の指示書と、点検の道具
persistent_shapes: book: SKILL.md with 4 semantic priorities (主張・比重・言い切りの強さ・文の働き) and 勝手に足さない
pocket: two bundled Python tools that leave the book for a separate lane
refs: 業務文書 used; 技術記事・個人発信 unused; 構文・語彙 references
pins: 残す条件 (4 for operation) that attach to the paper and stay attached
ai: ONE AI desk (Opus 5.5, saved production output; no live run)
sheet: the same paper moving paper slot -> AI desk -> 推敲後
lane: separate producer-executed Python lane with lint (after only) and diff (original + after, --stance=説明)
cards: saved candidate cards from concept/checks.json
compare: 原文 and 推敲後 papers joined by condition lines

scenes.title: 推敲の指示書と、点検の道具
scenes.sub: SKILL.md・参照資料と、同梱のPythonスクリプト2つ
scenes.conveys: The skill is an instruction book plus references plus two bundled scripts, not a model.
scenes.enter: Book and its four priority slips are visible at 0 s; the book opens (0-1.4 s).
scenes.exit: Business reference marked (1.7-4.4 s); lint and diff leave the book pocket for the dashed Python lane (2.5-3.7 s).

scenes.title: 原文・用途・条件を、同じAIへ
scenes.sub: 例：保存操作の説明（架空のマニュアル）
scenes.conveys: Book, references, original paper, context and condition pins all go into one AI.
scenes.enter: AI desk, paper, packet and pins appear (4.0-5.5 s); lines draw into the AI (5.0-6.4 s).
scenes.exit: The paper moves onto the AI desk (6.6-7.6 s) and the pins attach to it (6.8-7.8 s).

scenes.title: 言い回しを直し、条件は付けたまま
scenes.sub: 保存済みの変更「反映が実現されます」→「反映されます」ほか
scenes.conveys: Only wording changes; the condition pins stay on the same paper.
scenes.enter: 「反映が実現されます」 is struck and 「反映されます」 written (8.4-10.4 s).
scenes.exit: 「再起動を実施する」 -> 「再起動する」 (10.8-12.6 s). Both are substrings of saved changes[0] and changes[1].

scenes.title: 推敲後を、Pythonで別に点検
scenes.sub: lintは推敲後、diffは原文と推敲後（--stance=説明）
scenes.conveys: A separate producer-run lane: lint receives the after text; diff receives both texts. Tools do not write text.
scenes.enter: The paper becomes 推敲後 (13.2-14.2 s); fork lines draw (14.1-15.6 s).
scenes.exit: Copies travel: after -> lint, after -> diff, original -> diff (15.0-17.4 s).

scenes.title: 返ってくるのは見直し候補
scenes.sub: つなぎの出現数は、意味や品質の点数ではありません
scenes.conveys: Saved outputs: lint findings empty (指摘なし・候補0件); diff connector marker 2 -> 1.
scenes.enter: lint card (18.2-18.9 s), diff card 「つなぎ 2→1」 (19.0-19.7 s).
scenes.exit: Detail 「によって」→「と」 and 「ただし」は残る (20.2-21.0 s).

scenes.title: 原文と読み直し、保存済みの出力へ
scenes.conveys: The producer rereads source and output; unchanged wording reconnects; the existing saved file is what you take away.
scenes.enter: Cards connect to the compare papers (22.9-23.7 s); condition lines draw (23.8-25.2 s) with 「従来の設定が維持されます」 and 「画面上に残ります」 marked (24.4-25.2 s).
scenes.exit: outputs/operation.json appears and is outlined (25.7-27.0 s). No extra rewrite, loop or human approval is drawn.

scenes.title: 指示書から、使える推敲結果まで
scenes.sub: 本と入力 → AI → 別のPython → 読み比べ → JSON
scenes.conveys: Stable full path with every connection readable.
scenes.enter: All emphasis returns to full and every edge is traced in brick (28.3-28.9 s).
scenes.exit: Still from 29 s to 32 s; poster at 31 s.

quoted_strings_source: Every quoted phrase is read at runtime from the validated assets (concept/structure.json, concept/checks.json, samples.json, outputs/operation.json) and checked as an exact substring.

status.authored: source files written by claude-opus-5-5 without running a browser, renderer or MP4 encoder
status.review: pending; the producer adds actual verification records later
